name: L10-retry1
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the destination place — preserve its set, palette, outline weight and lighting. The SECOND image is the crowd exemplar — use only its anonymous crowd proportion and face tier.

The same shop seen from inside before dawn: the varnished oak counter and the bare shelf bays sit unlit across the foreground, and BEYOND THE WINDOW GLASS, OUTSIDE THE SHOP, ON THE PAVEMENT, a queue of overnight buyers curls away down the street in blue half-light. That whole queue and every one of its props stands OUTSIDE on the far side of the glass: the folding chairs, the sleeping bags, the flasks and the kerb they line are ALL on the pavement outdoors, and the breath showing in the cold is drawn ONLY on those outdoor figures. The shop's interior is EMPTY of people and empty of camping gear: nobody sits, stands or queues on the shop floor, no folding chair, sleeping bag or flask is inside the room, and no indoor figure shows breath. Framing: the camera stands BEHIND THE COUNTER, INSIDE the shop, looking OUT across the counter and through the shopfront window, so the counter is a near foreground edge running across the frame between the camera and the glass, and the glass splits the STILL, EMPTY interior in front of the camera from the PACKED street beyond it. Palette: blue-grey dawn outside, unlit warm brown inside.
